CustomField.description:
This formula will get the value of the Salesforce ID from this record if it has no parent or is GUD-level account. Otherwise will traverse up the hierarchy until it reaches the GUD-level account, and will get the Salesforce ID from it.
If GUD# not found - will populate LegacyId (former Siebel row_id)
CustomField.label: GUD # (Formula)
